title: LLM semantic-alias route table
description: The single authoring surface for every alias -> (provider, model, params, fallbacks, budgets, limits) mapping. The LiteLLM gateway config and the @adaptic/utils alias client are both derived from this file; neither may carry an independent mapping. Application code names only aliases (PD-5), so this table is where a model swap becomes a config change rather than a code change.

policy_source.description: Document and section this table implements, so a routing change is always traceable to the policy that authorised it.

request_timeout_ms.description: Hard per-leg timeout by latency class. A leg that exceeds its budget is abandoned and the chain advances; an unbounded LLM call is the engine's known brown-out mode (PD-3).

retries_per_leg.description: Retries within one route before the chain advances. Kept low: a retry on a dead provider spends the caller's latency budget that the next leg needs.

providers.description: Every account this programme can route to, open and closed alike. PD-11: closed providers are permanent members of this registry, never decommissioned entries.

tier.description: open = open-weight model host; closed = closed frontier vendor retained as a designated tier (PD-11); aggregator = multi-provider backstop.

api_key_env.description: Env-var NAME only. A key value must never appear in this file (PD-2).

account_status.description: pending-onboarding blocks canary promotion for any route naming this provider until W3 completes its human gates.

lumic_provider.description: The @adaptic/lumic-utils LLMProvider this maps to, when the degraded direct transport can serve it. Null means gateway-only.

aliases.description: Semantic aliases. Application code names exactly these (PD-5).

isolation_capable.description: PD-9: when true, a `<alias>.isolated` variant is generated with a dedicated key path and a dedicated log sink, and the shared sink must never receive it.

pinned.description: PD-6: a pinned alias is never auto-swapped and carries no fallback — it fails loud so a judge outage can never be silently substituted.

basis.description: A cap is a control and must be active before any production traffic (PD-7), but a cap set before the W1-03 billing baseline exists is provisional and must say so rather than pose as a measured figure.

role.description: Chain order is primary -> secondary -> closed_incumbent (PD-3). closed_incumbent is the permanent revert target (PD-11).

model_id.description: The vendor model string the gateway resolves the alias to. Null is only permitted while model_id_status is pending-provider-confirmation — a model id is transcribed from a provider doc at onboarding, never guessed.

model_id_source.description: Where a confirmed model_id was read from — a provider doc URL, or the in-repo registry that already routes on it.

lumic_model.description: The @adaptic/lumic-utils SupportedModel used by the degraded direct transport when the gateway itself is unreachable. Null means this leg is gateway-only.

supports_tool_choice.description: Whether the route is MEASURED to honour a mandatory tool_choice ("required"). Only true licenses sending it; serving stacks accept the parameter and silently answer in prose, so an unmeasured route omits it. The measurement must offer a tool that FITS the question: a model that declines a nonsense tool is not ignoring the constraint. Evidence: the engine llm-bench tool-choice probe (engine scripts/llm-bench/capability.mjs probeToolChoice), which on DeepInfra found Kimi-K3, GLM-5.3 and Ling-3.0-flash-Fin calling the offered tool, gpt-oss-20b calling a fitting tool and declining an irrelevant one, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro answering in prose even when the tool fits (2026-09-15); and, for Anthropic, the Messages API contract that a forced tool choice returns a tool_use block. A route whose exact model id that probe has not run on (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) stays false until it does.

shadow_only.description: Configured and continuously evaluated, but never served to a caller. Used where the backlog admits a model for shadow evaluation only.

open_items.description: Routing questions this table cannot answer on its own authority. Each blocks the G4 inventory-and-mapping sign-off until an owner decides.
